description: Display of single, high-resolution 50-inch LED digital display screen in shop window.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed Drawing Titled - Proposed Elevation.  
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - The maximum steady brightness of the signage hereby permitted is not to exceed [300] candelas per sq.m.
Reason: To ensure the sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - The sign hereby permitted shall only be illuminated and on between the hours of [0900] and [1900] Mondays to Sundays inclusive. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of nearby residents in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the NPPF.
Condition : 5 - The illumination of the sign(s) hereby permitted shall be by static illumination with no audio only.
Reason: In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.
